summary: Secondary pages and a route stack. ui/nav/RouteStack.kt: Route {SESSIONS, DIFF, TERMINAL, TASKS} and a saveable RouteStack scoped to host+session; Sessions and Diff mirror the view model's reader flags (sync pushes an opened reader and removes a closed one wherever it sits), Terminal and Tasks are navigation-only; back (top-bar arrow or system back via BackHandler) pops and closes the reader it leaves. ui/nav/SecondaryPage.kt: the page frame (top bar with back, actions, bottom bar) that shows the approval bar above every page's own bottom bar (LocalPageBanner), so approvals stay visible on pages. AppShell hosts the conversation and pages through a SaveableStateHolder: the conversation's LazyListState is restored when a page is popped (back from Diff lands at the same scroll position). Pages: ui/SessionsScreen.kt (search with IME Search, paging, resume with inline confirmation; replaces SessionsDialog), ui/DiffScreen.kt (full screen; per-file chips from the porcelain status, each loading that file's diff with the existing diff operation; patch coloured per line +/-/@@ via the shared patchText; paging/refresh/path; replaces DiffDialog), ui/TerminalScreen.kt (live terminal full screen with vertical follow and horizontal scroll; rows x cols computed from the viewport and a measured monospace cell, recomputed on every size change incl. rotation and keyboard, applied by 'Resize terminal' (shows RxC); key row (Esc, Tab, Ctrl-C, arrows, Enter, extra-keys menu, fit) and input in the bottom bar above the keyboard; open-terminal and history in the top bar; replaces TerminalSection.kt), ui/TasksScreen.kt (worktree task statuses with output/history/cancel, 'Browse worktree tasks' paged list, task composer pinned above the keyboard), ui/ModelSheet.kt (model panel as a bottom sheet from the model chip; replaces ModelDialog). Homes for the controls ZE-530 parked in the conversation header: session actions (sessions, conversation history, rename, new, diff, tasks, terminal) at the end of the top bar's chip row (SessionToolbar), message statuses as the newest conversation item, synchronization/error/unknown-write retry/connecting progress in a status strip under the top bar (StatusStrip), and the host/device controls below the inbox in the switcher drawer (inline, for the PairingScreen test adapter, they stay the conversation's oldest item). ui/ConversationSection.kt removed.

notes: Deviations / decisions: (1) Owned paths ui/nav/, ui/SessionsScreen.kt, ui/DiffScreen.kt, ui/TerminalScreen.kt, ui/TasksScreen.kt, ui/ModelSheet.kt (all new). Also touched: ui/AppShell.kt (route host, StatusStrip, host controls into the drawer), ui/ConversationScreen.kt (top bar session actions + status slot, message statuses item, ModelSheet), ui/SessionToolbar.kt (now the chip-row actions incl. Tasks/Terminal entries), ui/dialogs/BrowserDialogs.kt and SessionDialogs.kt (ModelDialog, DiffDialog, SessionsDialog removed), ui/ConversationSection.kt and ui/TerminalSection.kt deleted (contents moved to TasksScreen/ConversationScreen/TerminalScreen), screenshot tests. (2) Test migration: instrumented suites open the page first ('Desktop terminal', 'Worktree tasks' chip-row buttons; Sessions/Diff open from the view-model flag as before) and drop performScrollTo on top/bottom-bar controls; TerminalControlScreenTest checks the viewport-computed size instead of typed Rows/Columns (those fields are gone); SessionCatalogScreenTest uses performTextReplacement for the search box (performTextInput inserted at the cursor in front of the restored query, the ZE-530/532 pre-existing failure) and expects no Sessions page once no project is authorized; SessionScopeScreenTest expects the terminal page (and its input) to be gone after a session replacement; harness-only HostPairingTest/HeadlessHostTest/WorkspaceModelTest adjusted the same way but not runnable here. (3) Terminal sizing is applied on 'Resize terminal' rather than automatically, so the phone never silently resizes the desktop's PTY; the fit is recomputed continuously (rotation, keyboard). (4) Per-file diff uses the existing diff operation with a path (no protocol change); file list comes from the porcelain status lines; renames use the new path. (5) Pages are scoped to host+session: switching session returns to the conversation. Without any authorized project no page is shown. (6) Arch mode remains disabled (no remote operation).
